text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A and E at a gain felt satisfying, but buying them back later at higher prices reminded me that a realized gain is not, by itself, a reason to sell or repurchase.","I should not let reluctance to admit a mistake or the pain of a loss anchor my decisions to my average cost; I should reassess each holding on its merits.","These price changes do not reliably predict future moves. Since I trade infrequently and have made no trades through the recent decline, patience and avoiding unnecessary activity remain sensible."]}
